results.title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 2: Rivian Rallies on UBS Upgrade and Solid R2 Demand Outlook
results.author: Robert Izquierdo
results.description: Rivian Automotive surged 8.47% on November 2, 2026, following a UBS upgrade to Buy rating. UBS cited solid early R2 demand and a path to positive automotive gross margin as reasons for the upgrade, calling the recent selloff overdone. The company's Q3 results showed 38% year-over-year revenue growth to $2.2 billion, with the R2 becoming its best-selling vehicle by volume. A $1 billion term loan from the Volkswagen joint venture also provided additional liquidity support.

results.title: Tesla Has a Flying Car. What Does This Mean for Archer's Flying "Taxi" Business?
results.author: Steven Porrello
results.description: Tesla recently demonstrated a flying Roadster capable of brief flight, raising questions about competition with Archer Aviation's eVTOL air taxi. However, the vehicles serve different purposes: Tesla's is a single-passenger sports car for spectacle, while Archer's is a practical four-passenger aircraft designed for urban transportation. Archer is further along in FAA certification and more likely to reach market first, potentially benefiting from increased public interest in flying vehicles.
